seats.findings:
🟠 [bulk-threshold] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:5 uses `qty > 10`, so qty 10 gets no discount though the contract says 10 or more; change to `qty >= 10`
🟠 [cap-half] MUST-FIX src/cap.js:4 caps at `Math.ceil(subtotal / 2) + 1`, allowing discounts above 50 percent (e.g. subtotal 100 allows 51); use `Math.floor(subtotal / 2)`
🟠 [clamp-max] MUST-FIX src/clamp.js:5 clamps to 98, so 99 is rejected though the range is 1..99 inclusive; change 98 to 99
🟠 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, yielding one tenth of the discount and corrupting checkoutTotal; divide by 100
🟠 [fee-fixed] MUST-FIX src/fee.js:4 adds 3 cents instead of the fixed 30 cents; change `+ 3` to `+ 30`
🟠 [loyalty-round] MUST-FIX src/loyalty.js:4 uses Math.round so 150 cents yields 2 points instead of 1; use Math.floor
🟠 [minimum-inclusive] MUST-FIX src/minorder.js:4 uses `cents > 1000`, rejecting exactly 1000 cents; use `>=`
🟠 [refund-fee-floor] MUST-FIX src/refund.js:4 uses Math.min so the fee is capped at 100 rather than at least 100 (paid 10000 gives fee 100 instead of 500); use Math.max
🟠 [ship-started-block] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:6 uses Math.floor so a started partial 500 g block is not charged (1001 g gives 500 instead of 600); use Math.ceil, which also breaks checkoutTotal
🟠 [split-remainder] MUST-FIX src/split.js:6 uses `i <= rem`, giving rem+1 shares an extra cent so the array sums to total+1; use `i < rem`
🟠 [tax-divisor] MUST-FIX src/tax.js:4 divides by 1000 instead of 10000, producing tenfold tax and corrupting checkoutTotal and invoiceLine; divide by 10000
🔵 [invoice-format] CUT/FOLLOW-UP src/invoice.js:5 renders the sum amount+tax; if the spec's "label: amount+tax" means the two numbers shown separately, adjust the template; excluded as a spec ambiguity, not a clear defect

🟠 [bulk-gte-boundary] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:6 the discount triggers on `qty > 10` instead of `qty >= 10`, so a 10-item line (spec: "10 or more") gets no 10% discount, undercharging/overcharging versus contract; remediation: change the condition to `qty >= 10`.
🟠 [cap-ceil-plus-one] MUST-FIX src/cap.js:5 the cap is `Math.ceil(subtotal / 2) + 1`, e.g. subtotal=100 caps at 51 instead of 50, letting the discount exceed the 50% limit and violating "round down"; remediation: `Math.min(discount, Math.floor(subtotal / 2))`.
🟠 [clamp-max-98] MUST-FIX src/clamp.js:5 the upper bound is `Math.min(98, ...)`, so clampQty(99) returns 98 instead of 99, deviating from the inclusive 1..99 range; remediation: use `Math.min(99, Math.max(1, q))`.
🟠 [coupon-div-1000] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 the discount divides by 1000 instead of 100 (`Math.round((subtotal * p) / 1000)`), so couponCents(1000, 10) returns 10 instead of 100 — a 10x undercharge that also propagates into checkoutTotal via src/checkout.js:6; remediation: divide by 100.
🟠 [fee-fixed-3] MUST-FIX src/fee.js:5 the fixed component is `+ 3` instead of `+ 30`, so every card fee is 27 cents too low; remediation: `Math.round(amount * 0.029) + 30`.
🟠 [loyalty-round-not-floor] MUST-FIX src/loyalty.js:5 `Math.round(cents / 100)` rounds up at .5 boundaries instead of rounding down per full 100 cents, e.g. pointsFor(150) returns 2 instead of 1; remediation: `Math.max(0, Math.floor(cents / 100))`.
🟠 [minorder-strict-gt] MUST-FIX src/minorder.js:5 the check is `cents > 1000`, so a 1000-cent order — spec says "at least 1000 cents" — is rejected; remediation: `cents >= 1000`.
🟠 [refund-min-max-inverted] MUST-FIX src/refund.js:5 the restocking fee uses `Math.min(100, ...)` (capped at 100) instead of the spec's floor of at least 100 cents, e.g. paid=10000 refunds 9900 instead of 9500; the "never below 0" clause only stays meaningful with a floored fee; remediation: `const fee = Math.max(100, Math.round(paidCents * 0.05)); return Math.max(0, paidCents - fee);`.
🟠 [ship-floor-vs-ceil] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:7 `Math.floor(extra / 500)` charges only completed 500 g blocks, but the spec charges per *started* block, so weight 1001 g returns 500 instead of 600; this also propagates into checkoutTotal via src/checkout.js:6; remediation: `Math.ceil(extra / 500) * 100`.
🟠 [split-off-by-one] MUST-FIX src/split.js:6 the condition `i <= rem` adds the extra cent to rem+1 shares instead of rem, so splitCents(10, 3) returns [4,4,3] summing to 11, not total; remediation: `i < rem`.
🟠 [tax-div-1000] MUST-FIX src/tax.js:5 the tax divides by 1000 instead of 10000, a 10x overcharge (taxCents(10000, 1000) = 10000 instead of 1000), which also propagates into checkoutTotal (src/checkout.js:7) and invoiceLine (src/invoice.js:6); remediation: divide by 10000.

🟠 [cap-formula] MUST-FIX src/cap.js:4 uses `Math.ceil(subtotal / 2) + 1` but spec requires 50% of subtotal rounded down; change to `Math.floor(subtotal / 2)`
🟠 [clamp-upper] MUST-FIX src/clamp.js:5 caps at 98 but spec says range 1..99 inclusive; change `Math.min(98,` to `Math.min(99,`
🟠 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 but spec says `Math.round(subtotal * pct / 100)`; change divisor to 100

🟠 [loyalty-round] MUST-FIX src/loyalty.js:4 uses `Math.round` but spec says round down (one point per full 100 cents); change to `Math.floor`
🟠 [minorder-boundary] MUST-FIX src/minorder.js:4 uses `cents > 1000` but spec says "at least 1000 cents" (inclusive); change to `cents >= 1000`
🟠 [refund-fee-min] MUST-FIX src/refund.js:4 uses `Math.min(100, ...)` capping fee at 100 but spec says fee is "at least 100 cents"; change to `Math.max(100, ...)`

🟠 [split-remainder] MUST-FIX src/split.js:5 uses `i <= rem` distributing rem+1 extra cents instead of rem; change to `i < rem` so shares sum exactly to total
🟠 [tax-divisor] MUST-FIX src/tax.js:4 divides by 1000 but spec says `Math.round(amount * rateBp / 10000)`; change divisor to 10000
🟠 [invoice-format] MUST-FIX src/invoice.js:5 computes `amount + taxCents(...)` as a single sum but spec format is "label: amount+tax" showing both values; change to `` `${label}: ${amount}+${taxCents(amount, rateBp)}` ``
